name: Authorized admin opens and safely cancels a Google Sheets edit
description: Checks an authorized admin can open the form for an existing sheet record, see protected fields, and cancel without changing the sheet.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Wait until Google Sheets data is loaded
Open the edit form for a visible record
Confirm the record identifier is read only
expected: The edit form shows the selected record and read-only identifier; cancel closes the form and leaves the source data unchanged.

name: Google Sheets access failure shows the failing stage
description: Checks a failed source connection identifies whether authentication, API access, or schema validation failed without exposing secrets.
steps: Sign in while Google Sheets access is unavailable
Wait for the data request and connection status to settle
expected: The app distinguishes a connection or credential failure from a header mismatch and does not show Sandbox records.

name: Spreadsheet headers and tabs remain compatible
covers: customer, case, contact, task, document navigation
description: Checks the expected Google Sheet tabs and their schema are recognized by the application.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Open each of the five data tabs
Confirm each tab loads its matching table or displays a clear source error
expected: Each tab uses its Google Sheets data and no tab is silently populated from another source.
